name: Calcano-Martinez v. INS
summary: The Court reaffirmed that federal district courts retained habeas jurisdiction to consider legal challenges to removal orders, consistent with the reasoning in INS v. St. Cyr.
significance: Decided the same day as St. Cyr, this companion case reinforced the preservation of district court habeas jurisdiction for noncitizens challenging removal orders and is cited by petitioners for the breadth of that holding.
